caption: your sun is who you are. your venus is how you love. valentine's 2027: venus in capricorn, first quarter moon in taurus.

slides.headline: valentine's: *venus* wants a plan, mars is still walking backwards
*venus* in capricorn, the morning after a square to saturn
slides.body: venus squared saturn yesterday. the moon reaches first quarter in taurus this morning, then moves into gemini. and mercury is retrograde. it's a careful sky, not a cold one.

rows.label: plans
rows.text: a booked table beats a vague "let's see".

rows.label: words
rows.text: saying what you want, plainly, once.

rows.label: pace
rows.text: a second date with someone kind.

rows.label: you
rows.text: a night alone that you actually enjoy.

rows.label: tests
rows.text: waiting to see if they remember.

rows.label: scoring
rows.text: grading the gift instead of the effort.

rows.label: fire
rows.text: slow down. let them catch up to you.

rows.label: earth
rows.text: your night. venus speaks your language.

rows.label: water
rows.text: say the feeling before it turns into a test.

slides.headline: read their sky before their *selfies*
slides.body: venus stays in capricorn until march 1. a good stretch to choose someone for how they show up, not how they photograph.

slides.headline: *venus* runs your heart. let it be on time tonight.
slides.body: send this to your valentine. or your group chat.
